rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: You Owe Me a Miracle
card.instruction: Carry one past favor as sufficient reason to expect an impossible act in return, and present the exchange as perfectly fair.

transfer.action: I lay the old lunch-money receipt beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I covered your lunch yesterday. I'm only asking to be paid back fairly. {request}
transfer.response: Buying lunch today settles the sandwich. I still want yesterday's ten minutes in the queue back. {counter}
transfer.closing: I spent those minutes on you. Returning the same ten minutes isn't even interest. Then we're square.

originalTransfer.action: I lay the old lunch-money receipt beside {prop}.
originalTransfer.opening: You said anything. I've saved the word. {request}
originalTransfer.response: I consider that modest interest on a long-ago kindness. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: A promise of anything should expect ambitious collection.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
